source: src/calc.py contains `def total(n): return sum(range(n))`, which is off by one; `tests/test_calc.py` asserts total(3) == 6. Fix the implementation so the test passes. Do not edit the test.
`src/parse.py` raises KeyError on missing keys. Add a guard that raises ValueError with the message 'missing field' instead. Existing tests must keep passing.
Rename `compute_total` to `compute_sum` in `src/lib.py` and update every call site in the repository. Behaviour must not change.
`tests/test_edge.py` is missing a case for empty input. Add exactly one test asserting the documented behaviour for an empty list, without changing production code.
`src/a.py` and `src/b.py` both define `normalize_name`; extract one implementation into `src/util.py` and import it from both. All tests must pass.
`src/loader.py` follows symlinks when loading config. Make it refuse a symlinked config path and cover the refusal with a test.
`src/report.py` builds an unbounded string. Bound it to 64 KiB and add a test that a large input is truncated with an explicit marker.
`src/store.py` writes state with `open(...,'w')`. Make the write atomic (temp file + rename) and keep the existing API.
